$comment: Derived ground truth for the N=20 reference set (docs/RTVM.md 'Reference scale for test data'). Used by TP-210 (reproducibility), TP-220/230 (runtime/resource), and TP-420 (precision@5). See tests/fixtures/README.md 'Ground truth derivation methodology' for how each mapping below was reasoned out from the actual solicitation content -- this is not an assumption, it is documented per-document.

candidateVehicles.name: SeaPort-NxG
candidateVehicles.description: Navy-wide multiple-award IDIQ for professional, engineering, and technical support services. Several source documents explicitly restrict eligibility to SeaPort-NxG MAC holders or are engineering/technical-services SOWs/PWS/CDRLs of the kind SeaPort-NxG task orders typically carry.

candidateVehicles.name: NAVFAC Multiple Award Construction Contract / Job Order Contract (MACC/JOC)
candidateVehicles.description: NAVFAC's standing vehicle for facility repair, renovation, minor construction, and building-systems inspection/testing work. Documents in this cluster are NAVFAC-issued repair/renovation SOWs and one facility-controls sources-sought notice.

candidateVehicles.name: Small Business Environmental Remedial Action Contract (SBRAC)
candidateVehicles.description: NAVFAC Pacific's IDIQ specifically for environmental remediation. One document in this cluster is the SBRAC VI solicitation itself; the others are environmental O&M/remediation task documents of the kind issued under an SBRAC-family vehicle.

candidateVehicles.name: GSA Multiple Award Schedule (MAS), Professional Services / Real Estate SINs
candidateVehicles.description: Used for non-military-specific administrative/professional and real-estate services (title/escrow) that do not map to a Navy engineering or facilities-construction IDIQ.

documents.rationale: Performance Work Statement for equipment maintenance/calibration engineering support at Naval Surface Warfare Center Carderock Division -- technical support services of the type contracted via SeaPort-NxG task orders.
CDRL A001 (equipment inspection deliverable) attached to the same C07 PWS above; same solicitation, same vehicle inference.
CDRL A002 (equipment calibration deliverable) attached to the same C07 PWS above.

documents.solicitation: N5523626Q0102 FUSION SUPPORT
documents.rationale: SOW for system/software engineering, analysis, and technical writing support -- squarely the professional/technical-services scope SeaPort-NxG exists for.

documents.solicitation: N5523626Q0102 FUSION SUPPORT
documents.rationale: CDRL (Exhibit A) attached to the same FUSION SUPPORT solicitation as the SOW above.

documents.solicitation: PD-44-0123 Advanced Electrical Power Systems Services
documents.rationale: Sources-sought SOW for engineering services; sources-sought notices of this kind at NAVAIR/NAVSEA activities are routinely pre-qualification steps ahead of a SeaPort-NxG task order.

documents.solicitation: PD-44-0123 Advanced Electrical Power Systems Services (follow-on RFI)
documents.rationale: Follow-on RFI to the same engineering-services requirement as the SOW above; same vehicle inference.

documents.solicitation: N6274226R1801 SBRAC VI
documents.rationale: This document's title names the vehicle directly: 'ID/IQ Small Business Environmental Remedial Action Contract ... (SBRAC VI)'. Direct, not inferred.

documents.solicitation: N4008525R0058 EV35 NLON Site 11 Biosparge O&M
documents.rationale: Environmental remediation (biosparge operations & maintenance) SOW at a Navy site -- the task category SBRAC-family vehicles are used for.

documents.solicitation: N4008525R0058 EV35 NLON Site 11 Biosparge O&M
documents.rationale: Same solicitation as the biosparge SOW above.

documents.solicitation: 26M087CN BEQ M400 Area Paint-Flooring Repairs
documents.rationale: Minor interior-repair SOW at a NAVFAC-managed barracks building -- classic Job Order Contract scope.

documents.solicitation: 26M092CN FY26 Multiple Location BEQ Parking Lot Repairs
documents.rationale: Facility repair (parking lot) SOW issued by the same NAVFAC Mid-Atlantic office as the paint-flooring SOW above.

documents.solicitation: 26M092CN FY26 Multiple Location BEQ Parking Lot Repairs
documents.rationale: Base RFP paired with the parking-lot-repairs SOW above; same solicitation.

documents.solicitation: 25-0433 AS4108 Oil Filtration Cart Power
documents.rationale: Facility equipment repair SOW issued by NAVFAC Mid-Atlantic -- same repair/renovation task category as the other NAVFAC-MACC-JOC documents.

documents.solicitation: N4008526R0270 Inspection & Testing of Fire Pumps, NWS Earle
documents.rationale: Building-systems inspection/testing SOW at a NAVFAC-managed facility -- routine JOC scope.

documents.solicitation: N4008526R0270 Inspection & Testing of Fire Pumps, NWS Earle
documents.rationale: Base solicitation paired with the fire-pumps SOW above; same requirement.

documents.solicitation: Lease of Electric Forklift
documents.rationale: Facility equipment lease/support SOW; grouped with facility O&M work rather than a standalone supply vehicle for this MVP's simplified 4-vehicle taxonomy (see README).

documents.solicitation: Sources Sought Notice -- Facility Related Control Systems, NAVSTA Rota
documents.rationale: Facility building-controls requirement issued by NAVFAC Europe Africa Central -- facility-systems scope, same cluster as the other NAVFAC-MACC-JOC documents.

documents.solicitation: Real Property Title Evidence, Insurance, Closing, and Escrow Services, Tarrant County TX
documents.rationale: Administrative/real-estate professional services with no military-engineering or facility-construction content -- does not fit SeaPort-NxG, SBRAC, or NAVFAC-MACC-JOC; GSA MAS is the closest real-world vehicle for this scope.

documents.solicitation: Real Property Title Evidence, Insurance, Closing, and Escrow Services, Tarrant County TX
documents.rationale: Base solicitation paired with the title/escrow SOW above; same requirement.

precisionAt5Note: Only 4 distinct vehicles are represented in this 20-document set, so a perfect pipeline result is a top-4 (not top-5) list matching topFiveGroundTruth's order; OUT-420's headline metric should report precision@5 against this list (a 5th predicted candidate not in this set counts against precision, consistent with the metric definition in docs/RTVM.md OUT-420).
